Location:

featured_reviews.name: ARYAN NAYAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am giving this college 1 star only because of the visiting faculty. I completed just my first year of undergrad here and then changed college — which turned out to be the best decision.

This college was a horrible experience, especially because of the staff and the coordinator. They are not strict — they are rude, inhuman, and extremely egoistic for no reason. It functions exactly like a typical government college. A colossal waste of time. I’m genuinely grateful I left when I did.

I have had strict teachers in school, but they were always polite and professional. Here, the main faculty and staff were openly rude. I had some pending documentation work (which shouldn’t have been required since I was already a student). I went two days later, was told it wouldn’t be done, and still showed up every day at the HOD’s office for two weeks between 12–5 PM. I apologized formally with a signed letter. I traveled 2 hours every day just to get this sorted, and the HOD literally slammed the door in my face everytime . I was just 18 years old.

Thankfully, I changed colleges within two weeks after that. It was a completely toxic environment.

Lectures were scheduled from 12–5 PM, but after traveling 2 hours to attend, we would often be informed that the lectures were cancelled. There was no way to give feedback because of the extremely rude and egoistic HOD. Even parents of first-year students noticed how arrogant and disrespectful the HOD was.

The staff was horrible — lazy, unhelpful, and irresponsible. Nothing was ever done on time. Getting just one signature for a basic document from the principal (who comes every day) took an entire month because of the staff and they still did not do it . When I approached the principal’s assistant, he told me I could meet her anytime she was free. I went and the principal signed it in five minutes. The problem was clearly the staff and hod's, not the principal.

When I went to get my leaving certificate signed, another HOD(Senior one) taunted me about restarting somewhere else. I simply said it was better to leave a toxic environment, and it truly was. The college I eventually graduated from was actually good, and I am so glad I escaped this place as soon as possible.

Let’s ignore the staff, but the main coordinators will say harsh words that will break your self-confidence.

When I had left the college and just came to complete last formalities the Senior hod exactly said, " Restarting again, it’s such a waste of time, waste of everything." Imagine this one reply coming from the main hod a complete toxic environment.
The HOD are not strict, they are rude, ruthless, merciless and we have to beg for everything.

Fortunately, most of my first year was during COVID, so I was saved from experiencing more of this chaos — except for the last two months, which were enough to show me how bad things were.

Please do not enroll in any course here, especially not management courses. They will make you suffer.

The only good thing about this college was the visiting faculty. They were excellent, understood our concerns, and genuinely tried to help — but they had no authority since it was a government college. I realized the truth the hard way, after going through two miserable months. Even the student crowd wasn’t much of an issue — 99% of the problems came from the HOD and staff.

Fortunately, I got a lot time after joining my new college and with their support did a lot of things and upskilled my experience and myself.

A tip for recently 12th grade pass, please if you do not get into any college, take a gap but do not enroll here, this college will leave you mentally disturbed. I have faced it. It took a full 4 months for me to recover.

For BMS do not even enroll. Only if you are planning to study abroad or in another city next year and don't want to waste a year then for time pass you can enroll because literally that is the only thing that is done.

Horrible management

featured_reviews.name: KIRANKUMAR KHAMKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
This center is at walkable distance(5-6 mins) from churchgate railway station...
It has 2 small xerox & stationery shops right in front of the center building.... Right side xerox shop has xerox reduction facility incase your marksheets r of more than A4 size.. Also collect laminated enevelops as per no. of copies u want to attest...one copy has to be submitted to the center for their record, hence consider one copy extra for them..
Once you reach first floor, towards right first office you see is for attestation..
Floor has decent washroom and drinking water facility.
Entering office, on left side first you have to collect application form, which has token no. written on it...you can ask all your doubts and procedure while collecting form, they happily answer..
you have to go inside same room for document verification of originals in order of token no. ... Keeping checking with others which no. is going on, staff there dont call no. nor there is any display.. They only ring bell for next applicant..
Pls note u can avail attestion form only till 1pm..but form submission continues till 2.30pm... There is a lunch break in between 1-1.30pm but break gets spillover till 1.45-50 pm...after 2.30pm they distribute previous days attested copies...
Charges for attestation are 10 +1 Rs. each copy and at a time you can give max 25 pages...same lady who does document verification also collects fees and gives you receipt..
Also important is to keep copies in laminated envelops ready with WES/IQAS or whomsoever u want to address it, otherwise u will be sent back to do so...
For collection of attested copies they put intimation on their website...Website link to check completed attestation and procedure list is displayed on their notice board...
photos of that display notice has already been uploaded by some guys here pls check..

While collecting attested copies, first go to left side desks from where u had collected application form and deposit your receipt. Then one by one they will call your name as put on receipt and will handover attested copies to you.
In what order they call names for collection is not known, as during my time some people from one month and weeks prior submitted dates were also waiting, while some of last date were getting quickly.. So in actual it was very random distribution..but when someone enquired staff said it is on basis of dates...

They provide stamp on your envelop but they will not seal it. You have to check if every document is attested properly and have to seal it by yourself.

Also pls consider to courier all your transcript packages from respective colleges nearby courier centers, as i heard from sources that WES and IQAS has recently started rejecting applications if it is not couriered from institution due to increased fraudulent cases, but in India our colleges doesnt courier on their own, so to show that it was sent from institute only we have to courier it from nearby courier center..

featured_reviews.name: Adriel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Marksheets, certificate and transcript attestation:
- Get transcripts from the college that you attended.
- Make photocopies of the marksheet and certificates etc. in sets (+1 extra set of photocopy as the attesting office will retain a copy for their records)
- Carry an A4 envelope for every set of copies made
- Write the address of the destination (WES Canada / college that you are applying to..). This is a must.
- Visit Vidyarthi Vidyapeeth Bhavan which is at the sode of Churchgate station, be there early and register on the ground floor. Your serial number on the ground floor is your token number. Proceed to the 1st floor and collect the form which has your corresponding token number.
- Note that at 1pm the registration stops and you will not receive a form.
- carry original of all certificates for verification.
- wait in line and enter the office as per serial token number (same number on form)
- Handover all transcripts, mark-sheets and certificates, after verification your originals will be returned.
- There is a nominal charge for attesting the documents, you will will receive a receipt.
- Retain the receipt as it is required to collect the attested documents.
- Not more than 25 documents are attested at a time.

Collection:
- Returned 10days later and produced the receipt, was asked to wait
- About 5min later name was called and attested copies along with the stamped envelope on the front from University of Mumbai Registrar as well as along the flap with signature was handed over

DHL is around the corner, dispatched it from there to WES.
